name: Mzuzu
queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Chichewa discovery found official Malawi Ministry of Lands/Department of Surveys custody, including Mzuzu regional offices and stated cadastral/registry-map/Land Information System functions. The public LIMS shell was retrieved anonymously but points to account login/registration for parcel access. MASDAP was identified as a public GIS platform, but its certificate was expired during the request and TLS was not bypassed. No safe anonymous parcel ID plus polygon response was obtained.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if source-proven
scopeLimits: No citywide completeness or absence claim.
No coordinate shift or exact-point absence inference.
Local/regional custodian and procedure evidence is distinct from a verified public parcel-feature endpoint.
No credentials, registration, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, or TLS bypass was used.
No raw source-specific fields were retained.

qualification.reason: Official cadastral custodian and Mzuzu regional/procedural evidence exist, but public anonymous parcel schema, CRS, native identity, geometry, and coverage remain unverified.

uncertainty: Authenticated LIMS access or a functioning public MASDAP service may change the result; current evidence cannot qualify an adapter.
